title: VCPS handoff record
description: Structural schema for .vcps/handoffs/HND-*.md frontmatter. Owned in content by standard/portability.md SS4 (VCPS-PORTABILITY-006) and templates/contract.md's handoff field list. By design this record REFERENCES version/level/lifecycle/gate state by current source rather than duplicating it as a frozen snapshot that could drift. NEW_CANONICAL_RECONSTRUCTION authored 2026-10-06; see evaluation/completion-roadmap.md Phase B.

step.description: The workflow step/stage this handoff was produced at, e.g. 'Stage 6' for SETUP.

project_ref.description: Fixed singleton pointer; version/level/lifecycle/gate outcomes are obtained through this reference, never restated here (VCPS-PORTABILITY-006).

pending_checkpoint.description: Null only when nothing is pending. When present, every field is required so the next session can resume without re-deriving it (VCPS-PORTABILITY-006).

next_actions.description: Concise next actions for whoever resumes this work.

supersedes_ref.description: A new handoff supersedes an old one (templates/contract.md); the old record is retained.
